9a014f67a8930a0f0785ba97eb9e1cd35296925c.RewardText: The totem has various primal markings. You see owls, bears, wolves and stags carved into the surface of the totem.$B$BYou note a strange collection of symbols that makes your mouth form the word C-O-O.

9a0739d279873b353f0e788af2856a47057522ce.Text: Don't you hate it when you get punked by a GNOME?!

9a08714609e86c961d894bd566a329b9b810dccf.RewardText: Keb'ezil is relieved that you've taken care of that little problem, aren't you, Keb?$B$B<The imp ignores its master, presumably out of indignation.>$B$BYou'll have to forgive his bad manners. You know how demons can be...

9a0ad07663b579795723a82e5310ccaa0f2250a6.scope: Direct quest-required loot and item requirement; not the NPC giving/receiving this quest, shared personhood, allegiance, effective current availability or completed outcome.

9a0dc760ce04455d3ae5243f3904abd0c2ac2055.RewardText: Excellent work, $N. There is certainly a latent power here, one that not even constant exposure to the corruption of the satyr can dim. Do you see how it still shines, after all these years?

9a0f78300c36d07f7a5ef9824f61d986d3a1bb28.Text: Blood? And these orcs, these fair weather friends? They will aid us?

9a0f85a8874add0f59f0aac6cc7a125a9c60a947.LogDescription: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Hodir's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Hodir's Sigil, consult the Archivum Console.
9a0f85a8874add0f59f0aac6cc7a125a9c60a947.QuestDescription: Hodir's Sigil won't be easy to obtain.  Not only are ye going to have to defeat Hodir himself, but yer going to have to do it before he destroys the chest that contains it!$B$BCheck the Archivum console if you need more information.  That thing contains more knowledge than all of the world's libraries put together!

9a1c4c94428a10c94cbb0735a404d6f34ac3cd75.RewardText: Blood and thunder! You've salvaged our newborn relations with the taunka.$b$bThank you for putting the situation to rights. Aka'Magosh, $N!

9a1d432d94bbdcf79beaeb22b4526a68f5ab5c8d.LogDescription: Kill Fenwick Thatros and bring his head back to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.
9a1d432d94bbdcf79beaeb22b4526a68f5ab5c8d.QuestDescription: Lord Varimathras has just sent me a missive about a threat to the Forsaken that must be immediately removed. His name is Fenwick Thatros, one whom Lord Varimathras believes is a leader of the undead that have taken root in Silverpine Forest.$b$bYour name came to mind immediately, $n. I have faith enough in your abilities that you will carry out this mission flawlessly.$b$bThe latest reports from the Deathstalkers in Silverpine indicate that Thatros can be found near the decrepit dock on Lordamere.

9a217333a2c5d074a36ffac248022c6a610fda53.RewardText: Hail, death knight. I am the blood lord, Keleseth, ruler of the southeastern reaches of Northrend. The Lich King has sought to utilize my talents in ending this mortal affront to the Scourge. As with all things the Lich King asks of me, I am happy to oblige. Of course, a sea of endless souls to sate my thirst certainly sweetened the deal, don't you think?

9a22542481a22bfa5d99ccd05c21452a05aed2a4.LogDescription: Kill 12 Wastes Diggers and 1 Wastes Taskmaster at the digs surrounding Galakrond's Rest.  Return to Narf at Nozzlerust Post when the task is complete.
9a22542481a22bfa5d99ccd05c21452a05aed2a4.QuestDescription: You, $c!  These undead south of us are being a constant nuisance to our work.  Go clear them out, will ya?

9a23bed2613e1619ccb3f023b99195ee23c65cc1.LogDescription: The Festival Loremaster wants you to take Summer Incense to a Summer Scorchling outside any Alliance settlement.
9a23bed2613e1619ccb3f023b99195ee23c65cc1.QuestDescription: Did you know that our festival fires burn in every land with an Alliance settlement? Flame Wardens tend to them in camps outside of each town, ensuring the bonfires are bright and the celebrations continue.$b$bWith each Flame Warden is a summer scorchling -- an emissary to the elemental spirits of fire.$B$BWould you like to honor a scorchling, $N?  Take this summer incense and bring it to any summer scorchling.  Appease the little fire spirit, and it may reward you.

9a25967231861c5c81a9211503958fb5fe29a020.LogDescription: Librarian Serrah in the Transitus Shield needs you to kill Arcane Serpents near the Nexus and collect 5 Nexus Mana Essences from them.
9a25967231861c5c81a9211503958fb5fe29a020.QuestDescription: Our existence here depends entirely upon staying hidden. Should the shield fail, even for a moment, Malygos' minions would have us.$b$bOne of my responsibilities is to rejuvenate the warmages' mana levels so their focus doesn't falter. With our supply lines lost, I've been forced to improvise.$b$bI could use your help, $n.$b$bVery near the Nexus, Arcane Serpents feast on the abundant magical energies. Once defeated, they will yield a mana essence that I can make use of.

9a25a87341f789975eae0f6bfd517c2278899990.Text: True, Northrend is a hard land, but our people are strong, hardy, and equal to the task!

9a25d52a9c706f0458ecfd5a5e167f637d054661.Text: Toss me?! Okay, that's it punk.

9a287c4e97f97128c1b6a633955e5144abc58184.RewardText: Kindal was right about you, $N--you do have a knack for this. You are a more seasoned adventurer than the both of us, and for that we thank you.$B$BThe Grimtotem clan is much more hostile than most tauren... I wonder if their own kind frowns upon their actions. I wouldn't be surprised. As you are probably aware, many races on Azeroth have ties to less kindly counterparts.$B$BBut that is a discussion for another day.

texts.text0_0: Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff.  You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here.  All denizens of the Horde are welcome here.$B$BThe spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend.  Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself.

9a2ddd722c594a6838d073afe8642ab76894226c.LogDescription: Travel to Seer Graytongue who lives in the hills directly south of Camp Narache.
9a2ddd722c594a6838d073afe8642ab76894226c.QuestDescription: Your willingness to perform a humble task for the tauren of Narache and your eagerness to learn are noble traits, $n. I believe one day you will be heralded in Thunder Bluff as a $c of greatness.$b$bBefore that you must embark on the Rites of the Earthmother, of which there are three.$b$bThe first test is the Rite of Strength. Travel to Seer Graytongue and tell him Chief Hawkwind has sent you.$b$bYou will find the seer's abode directly to the south of Camp Narache, tucked away in the hills.

9a2f71be909048b8cb7a3b61683e56970b5bdfb2.Text: You went behind my back.  You neglected my orders.  You will pay the price.

9a303266266bc4270f403d4a44f429ee2e6aa9ac.comment: Razzashi Venombrood - In Combat - Cast 'Intoxicating Venom'

9a3690765d03b878e12137282af3641df507cf92.LogDescription: Slay Captain Zorna and report to Baron Freeman at Venture Bay.
9a3690765d03b878e12137282af3641df507cf92.QuestDescription: The Horde's forces are poised to break through our lines and complete their conquest of Venture Bay if we do not act. The Horde's forces in the port are commanded by Captain Zorna, near the ship on the far side of the bay.$B$BIf you can defeat her, the Horde's offensive will falter and we can seize the chance to capture the port. Beware, $N, for Zorna is a fierce fighter. It may take several people to defeat her, or if you have access to a repaired shredder, you might try using it to your advantage.

texts.text0_0: You need to be stronger, $c before you can help us in Alterac Valley.
texts.text0_1: You need to be stronger, $c before you can help us in Alterac Valley.

9a377ba492eae40de0d6faed21af570841c9eec9.RewardText: By my beard! This holds a power to rival a fleet of our flying machines! I'll give it to my war priests and we'll devise a plan to send those vile necropolises scurrying back to Northrend... and we'll be right behind them!$b$bOh, Muradin my brother, you must live! By the honor of the Bronzebeards, I will find you!

9a3f6730bc4b5e3a94986554563b0777ec01bd71.LogDescription: Kill 10 Syndicate Rogues and 10 Syndicate Watchmen. Return to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill for your reward.
9a3f6730bc4b5e3a94986554563b0777ec01bd71.QuestDescription: By the authority of Lady Sylvanas, all members of the organization known as the Syndicate are wanted dead. Those brought into custody or taken prisoner will be summarily executed. They are currently known to be amassing in the ruins of Durnholde Keep, to the southeast of Tarren Mill.$b$bA handsome reward is offered to all who bring proof of their deeds to High Executor Darthalia.

9a435ee6c9fe222a7ac8091639a5d480603a6186.LogDescription: While wearing your Cult Disguise,speak to Cultist Kagarn,Cultish Agtar,Cultist Tokka,and Cultist Rokaga at the Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.
9a435ee6c9fe222a7ac8091639a5d480603a6186.QuestDescription: Aside from the disturbances and the paranoia spread by the cult,we've been inundated with reports of missing people. Mothers,fathers,brothers,and sisters have seemingly disappeared,but I have a feeling that they can be found in one of the cult's compounds outside the city. If I give you the names of some of the missing people,would you try to locate them in the cultist camp at the Jaggedswine Farm south of Orgrimmar? To blend in,you'll need to get a robe from one of the doomsayers in the Drag.

9a4791b9ff7d8956a2bf5ba30f6367b2c978831f.Text: There we are, $n.  The toxin is ready.

9a509dfbc137ad8a7d718f5c04e246024da3ba19.LogDescription: Obtain 10 Oshu'gun Crystal Fragments and bring them to Gezhe at Aeris Landing in Nagrand.
9a509dfbc137ad8a7d718f5c04e246024da3ba19.QuestDescription: Nexus Prince Haramad has ordered us to not begin work inside of Oshu'gun as it might anger a certain powerful naaru.  Sort of puts a damper on our operation.$B$BI think I might've found a loophole, however.$B$BYou see, we're not the only ethereals drawn to this colossal diamond.  A thief called Gava'xi has led a band of rogue ethereals into Oshu'gun and they've begun to dislodge large fragments from it.$B$BYour job, $r, is to go there and retrieve what is rightfully ours.

9a54028dcde11b45faa036936148d2036b6a7554.LogDescription: Kill Princess, grab her collar, then bring it back to Ma Stonefield at the Stonefield Farm.
9a54028dcde11b45faa036936148d2036b6a7554.QuestDescription: The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess.  The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!$B$BSo before she comes to our fields...Princess must die!  Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!$B$BPrincess is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm.  Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!

9a5469de985f82643b09e40062dda2a339ac6c00.comment: Edana Hatetalon - on Just summoned - move forward

9a5abc9972edd18a8150294f67a20bdfdd0dc6fa.RewardText: Oh how happy these little woodland nymphs shall be! We'll make them feel right at home with this special concoction!

9a5b60e0ad4a33d88f79f9e2dd505ee697ab4ab5.LogDescription: Read the Stillpine Furbolg Language Primer that Aurren gave you and interact with the Totem of Akida at Azure Watch.
9a5b60e0ad4a33d88f79f9e2dd505ee697ab4ab5.QuestDescription: I think I've cracked it, $N!$B$B<Aurren points to the totem.>$B$BAll that we need to know about the Stillpine furbolg language is imprinted on their totems. With just a rudimentary understanding of how their symbols work, we can study the totems and learn to communicate with the furbolgs.$B$BI've written down the basics of the symbol matrix on this parchment. Study it and then examine the totem. It should lead you to the next language totem.$B$BSpeak to Arugoo when you return an educated $r!

9a5ce230bb5742c6bc96d8bed59caa7fa8181b17.RewardText: The horns of war will soon echo across this land, waking the dead and calling forth the Scourge war machine. Woe unto those that would stand in our way!$B$BYou and your brethren will lead the charge, $N. When next I look upon the Scarlet lands, my sight will be obscured by the legions of Acherus. The march upon New Avalon begins now.

9a5cf1b2d3e3a58c072871473677253323cdc91e.Text: They killed hundreds! We barely escaped with our lives! Help!

9a5e76dafebec5ea83664a585927dc841452e826.Text: I will be reborn, mortals! Incendius shall raise me from these ashes!

9a60838f9167778d12d4e71564c631e1d2b821a3.RewardText: Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...$B$B<Mathrengyl peers into the shard>$B$BOh... I didn't... Well.$B$B$N, thank you for delivering this to me. It isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that the Cenarion druids alone must attend to.$B$BLet's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...$B$BPerhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.

texts.text0_0: You have reached the limits of my knowledge, but there is more yet to learn. Across the sea, in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City, a great tailor dwells. His name is Georgio Bolero, and he will train you now, I think. Go and speak with him.

9a6bd8b4c6496704b20e48aa383b32bb838d7f1d.warning: Context/conditions not assigned; use only stable supported identity, never infer availability.

9a6c9f64b7127fcf4e90a7ae4c84d0cd3270c5e9.Text: TAUREN CHIEFTAINS! Playing LIVE, in the WORLD'S END TAVERN! Be there, at the top of the hour! Banished from Shattrath? SNEAK BACK IN!

9a6d5f1400f093206270895b641fc3f130c47782.RewardText: Aha! So the raptors did hide the silver at their lair. It's hard to believe these beasts would have the desire for silver. Perhaps the stories of their intelligence are not as far from the mark as I thought!$B$BThank you, $N. Take this as a reward for your service to us, and know that the guards of the crossroads owe their next month's pay to you.

9a6e16cd1f08db9743512eec7ee11d108f6ebf41.LogDescription: Bring three Snickerfang Jowls, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one Scorpok Pincer to Bloodmage Drazial.
9a6e16cd1f08db9743512eec7ee11d108f6ebf41.QuestDescription: It is a well known fact that hyenas possess tremendous strength in their jowls, but the strength to snap through three inches of thorium steel? Impossible, improbable, and yet I have seen this demonstrated with my own eyes.$B$BVenture forth, into the Blasted Lands, and bring me three snickerfang jowls. As you search for the snickerfang, be on the lookout for boars and scorpoks: The initial assay also requires two blasted boar lungs and one scorpok pincer to complete.

9a734476d80e7aafb7948de7ddafb77badeb2f7e.LogDescription: Jol wants you to resurrect a Young Furbolg Shaman with the Symbol of Life and return to her.
9a734476d80e7aafb7948de7ddafb77badeb2f7e.QuestDescription: Your task then, $N, is to aid our new allies, the Stillpine furbolgs.$b$bSeveral of the younger Stillpine shaman stumbled across a Bristlelimb camp and were slaughtered to the last.  Take this Symbol of Life and resurrect one of the shaman.$b$bBristlelimb Enclave is located to the east of the road just after you cross the bridge spanning Azuremyst and Bloodmyst Isle.  Speak with me when you have done this.$B

9a73874d899c342f8f7541bcc647d4741401c2d7.Text: Why is Thrall allowing this to happen to our city?

9a7ed084f5ce95b3693bc6097b289b115d2816c3.Text: Emergency shutdown will complete in thirty seconds.

9a7f6d4f1e133d24957b2ff0f4141ff081cc2290.Text: You know what they say about curiosity....

9a8055f50cea5239a63402bf16e4a81c267c0054.LogDescription: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.$B$BMarkhor mentioned that his brother's remains were fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch. He also mentioned that there is a refuse pit filled with oozes in Jintha'alor as well as a wolf den. Both of these places are near the top of the temple.
9a8055f50cea5239a63402bf16e4a81c267c0054.QuestDescription: Like many in our village, I too have lost a loved one to the wilds. Alas, it was my twin brother Malkhor - taken in the same raid as Torntusk's mate by the Vilebranch.$B$BSadly, he was not fated to live and was given a swift, brutal execution; his remains fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch.$B$BIt is too late to save his life but not too late to save his soul. Recover his remains, $N.

9a844badf12d3069571c93b5d159a3d1d398dd67.comment: Nerub'ar Sky Darkener - In Combat - Cast 'Web Bolt'

9a870bdce107309dcbe57c7adf88b7615ba1b71e.LogDescription: Kill Murlocs of the Silting Shore to summon a Quel'dorei Magewraith, then destroy it. Afterwards, speak with Bati at the Vault of Lights in the Exodar.
9a870bdce107309dcbe57c7adf88b7615ba1b71e.QuestDescription: You have chosen the path of the $c, and so you must learn control. Magic, when unchecked, can corrupt souls and destroy worlds.$b$bTo fully understand, you must face one who has been consumed by magic. Travel to the beaches on the northwest coast of Azuremyst Isle and use your spells to decimate the murlocs. The display of power will attract the attention of the evil force lurking there, a Quel'dorei magewraith. Defeat it.$b$bWhen you have finished, seek out Bati at the Vault of Lights in the Exodar.

9a8c34447fa4c374a5b4254f00d53fb02554485f.comment: When in combat and timer at the begining between 0 and 1000 ms (and later repeats every 0 and 0 ms) - Self: Cast spell Sarilus's Elementals (6490) on Self

9a8c41b40d1e155c96a93bb13cc2fd30be9d1c0c.comment: Vrykul Necrolord - IC - Cast Tug Soul

9a8de8538f83a05f78b640dbf3790359d0bda6a4.LogDescription: While disguised as a package-runner, go to the Crown Chemical Company's stockpile outside the gates of Stormwind, then return the package they toss you to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind.
9a8de8538f83a05f78b640dbf3790359d0bda6a4.QuestDescription: I knew they were up to no good! There's some sort of mind-affecting chemical in here, but I can't get a handle on it with such a small sample. I need the real stuff.$B$BDon't just go over there and buy it! I don't want you giving these scumbags one copper. Nah, you gotta get it from the source, discreet-like.$B$BI'll disguise you as a package runner. I saw a stockpile guarded by their goons outside the gates. Go run by, and DON'T stop, or they'll make you! They'll toss you a crate. Bring it back here.

9a93cdc60aaa71ace82d59c396df3c60499ab68e.Text: Tomorrow we will begin training of our promising dragons, so don't forget your chew toys.

parent_speech.Text: For every Horde soldier that you killed -- for every Alliance dog that fell, the Lich King's armies grew. Even now the val'kyr work to raise your fallen as Scourge.
Things are about to get much worse. Come, taste the power that the Lich King has bestowed upon me!
Join me, father. Join me and we will crush this world in the name of the Scourge -- for the glory of the Lich King!
Stubborn and old. What chance do you have? I am stronger, and more powerful than you ever were.

9a9aaf667e38188c1cce31020c99f54841cdd130.RewardText: Hmmm... strangely enough I don't feel any better about my brother's death at the hands of those brutes.$B$BWell, you held your end of the bargain. Let's see what I can do for you.

9a9b76f193a3494014e9a0b7314b1cf4aa2f3165.LogDescription: Captain Harker aboard the Windrunner wants you to kill 15 North Fleet Marines.
9a9b76f193a3494014e9a0b7314b1cf4aa2f3165.QuestDescription: This should have been a walk in the park.  Their forces are hungry, injured and ill equipped.  Yet somehow, we walked right into their trap.$B$BWe approached these reefs from the south to gain cover and were immediately boarded by the Alliance dogs.$B$BI'm sorry to say, if you want our cannons to fire at anything, you're going to have to help us take our ships back.

9a9c86fd22d635fee6bc0cd578bee6b9ee32a828.LogDescription: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard and speak with him, then speak to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.$B$BIf you lose Brann's Communicator, speak with Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.
9a9c86fd22d635fee6bc0cd578bee6b9ee32a828.QuestDescription: What are you waiting for? The language barrier has been broken, thanks to Moteha. Contact Brann Bronzebeard and find out anything you can about where he's hiding and what he's chasing after.$B$BMaybe we can still salvage something from this disaster.

9a9c87b60ad5e78f3a9e945dcf345e5b03052823.Text: New directive: assist in the defeat of the iron dwarves.
